storage: Keep packaged pav in its pouch at room temperature and use within a few days; bakery pav is best the same day. Freeze with the pouch sealed for about a month (general guidance, not from a source in this run) and warm on a tawa before use.
looksLike: Small, soft, pale rolls baked joined in a block (a "ladi"), golden on top, white where the rolls were pulled apart. Each roll is roughly 35 g (the dish file puts 2 rolls at about 70 g).
howToPick: Soft and springy to the touch, springs back when pressed, even golden top, no sour or yeasty-sharp smell, no mould spots or dry hard edges. Check the packing date; packaged pav is a short-shelf-life product.
shelfLife: A Harvest Gold Bombay Pav listing on Instamart states 5 days from the date of manufacture (https://www.swiggy.com/instamart/p/harvest-gold-bombay-pav-N5P4O80P1S). Bakery pav is best the same day or next day.

usedIn.raw: 2 pav (about 70 g) per serving, 2 rolls from a ladi
